context: Hiroshi-boss invites Sho-young to bring-your-child-to-work day briefly.
purpose: Authority figure showing child working world warmly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: The boss's company is so huge!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded wonder. Quick opening on 「社長」. Warm and clear, the natural speech-rush of a six-year-old discovering something big. Slight breathless quality on 「広い」.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おう、ここで皆、仕事しとる。
lines.style: Gentle, conversational. Warm but grounded. A slight smile in the voice, not condescending. Matter-of-fact delivery, as if explaining something simple to someone he wants to include.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: What kind of work do they do?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not performing. Soft and engaged, the real question of a thoughtful child. Slight pause before 「仕事」 — he's processing. Open, interested tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 人を笑顔にする仕事や。
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath the gentleness. Speaks slowly, as if handing him something true. Tender but not sentimental. Slight breath before the answer, like this matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: That's so cool — I want to do that too!
lines.style: Pure delight, no performance. Bright attack on 「いいなぁ」. Earnest and young, the kind of enthusiasm that's unguarded. Slight rise at the end, like he's offering something to Hiroshi.
